'Is cobble-synced with' is symmetric..why: Made up for this record: the relation 'is cobble-synced with' is invented; the instances in the prompts are real services. Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by this name; only unrelated near-spellings.

notes: Fictional relation, real instances (Dropbox, Google Drive, Git, Mercurial). The direct question asks the opposite property, so its answer is no (Rule 9 balance). The second instance asks a negated reverse, which symmetry contradicts: no.
